name: vc-agent
description: Single-user desktop agent for Project and Unscoped VC work.
author: VC Agent

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @vc-agent/agent-worker build && pnpm --filter @vc-agent/utility-worker build && pnpm --filter @vc-agent/desktop build
scripts.package:verify-inputs: pnpm exec esbuild scripts/verify-packaging-inputs.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=test-results/verify-packaging-inputs.cjs && node test-results/verify-packaging-inputs.cjs
scripts.package:win:dir: pnpm build && pnpm parser-runtime:prepare && pnpm package:verify-inputs && electron-builder --win dir --x64
scripts.package:win: pnpm build && pnpm parser-runtime:prepare && pnpm package:verify-inputs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.integration-gate: pnpm exec esbuild scripts/run-integration-gate.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=test-results/run-integration-gate.cjs && pnpm vitest run tests/host-services/integration-gate.test.ts && node test-results/run-integration-gate.cjs
scripts.integration-gate:release: pnpm exec esbuild scripts/run-integration-gate.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=test-results/run-integration-gate.cjs && pnpm vitest run tests/host-services/integration-gate.test.ts && node test-results/run-integration-gate.cjs --require-pass
scripts.personal-build-gate: pnpm exec esbuild scripts/run-personal-build-gate.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=test-results/run-personal-build-gate.cjs && node test-results/run-personal-build-gate.cjs
scripts.personal-build-gate:release: pnpm exec esbuild scripts/run-personal-build-gate.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=test-results/run-personal-build-gate.cjs && node test-results/run-personal-build-gate.cjs --require-pass
scripts.office:compat: pnpm exec esbuild scripts/run-real-office-compat.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=test-results/run-real-office-compat.cjs && node test-results/run-real-office-compat.cjs
scripts.mcp:compat: pnpm exec esbuild scripts/run-real-mcp-compat.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=test-results/run-real-mcp-compat.cjs && node test-results/run-real-mcp-compat.cjs
scripts.sub-agent:compat: pnpm build && pnpm exec esbuild scripts/run-real-sub-agent-compat.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:@playwright/test --external:playwright --external:playwright-core --external:fsevents --external:chromium-bidi/* --outfile=test-results/run-real-sub-agent-compat.cjs && node test-results/run-real-sub-agent-compat.cjs
scripts.h1:packaged: pnpm build && pnpm exec esbuild scripts/run-packaged-h1-evidence.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=test-results/run-packaged-h1-evidence.cjs && node test-results/run-packaged-h1-evidence.cjs
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e
